rules.statement: A final decree under the Partition Ordinance is only binding and conclusive if it was 'given as hereinbefore provided', which includes essential steps such as investigation into titles, declaration of rights, and direction to partition specific land.
rules.supporting_quote: "It has been held in several cases that when a decree under the Partition Ordinance is pleaded as a basis of title, it is open to the party against whom it is pleaded to show that it is not a decree 'given as hereinbefore provided, ' and so, has not the conclusive effect given to decrees under section 9."
